reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-team message to say I'd noted the deadline: the signed order form for Quarrendon Freight Lines is due 7 October.

I also pointed out that 7 October was nine days before their message, which was sent on 16 October. If the form is still outstanding, or the date should be a different month or year, they may want to check it. I couldn't verify the date because nothing I read in #north-team mentions an order-form deadline for Quarrendon, so the date rests only on what Ilse said. As they asked, I took no other action.
